biggest_gap: In B, replace the empty subhead "How to read this board." and the collapsed "Notes for the Rookie (6)" with two sentences that show without tapping and are written for the Rookie profile. They should say what this list is and what the pipeline decided today, for example "1 buy, 3 to watch, 17 skipped; CRWD is the only buy, at a 3% position". Each row below it should also carry its BUY/WATCH verdict, the company name and a labeled "position size" column, so the green 3%/1.5% figures stop reading as returns.
evidence: A frames its list completely at a glance: a clear title, who made it and when it was updated, one plain sentence saying what the list is, the item count, and rows that pair each ticker with a company name. B's frame says it will explain the board, then hides the explanation behind a disclosure. Its 1/3/17 counts don't map to any row, and its right column is unlabeled green percentages beside green % changes, so a new investor can't tell which stock is the buy or what 3% means.
